findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Baixe o livro offline
findings.proposition: The offline handbook is downloaded by right-clicking the GitHub link https://github.com/appliedepi/epirhandbook/raw/main/offline_long/index.html and choosing "Save link as".
findings.reader_consequence: The Portuguese section tells the reader an offline HTML version exists but never gives the download link or the download action, so the reader cannot obtain the offline handbook from this page at all.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Baixe o livro offline
findings.proposition: On a Mac use Cmd+click, on mobile press and hold the link and select "Save link", and if a page of raw HTML code appears the instructions were not followed.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader on macOS or mobile has no platform-specific instruction, and if raw HTML opens in the browser they get no explanation that they clicked instead of saving.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Baixe o livro offline
findings.proposition: A fourth bullet instructs the reader to install the appliedepidata R package, which contains all the example data, with the installation process described below.
findings.reader_consequence: The Portuguese reader is given an offline-preparation step the English list does not contain; it is presented as part of the offline checklist, so a reader comparing versions or following an English-based course sees an instruction that does not exist upstream.

findings.heading: Case linelist / "Linelist" de casos
findings.proposition: The cleaned linelist .rds preserves column classes and therefore guarantees that only minimal cleaning is needed after importing it into R.
findings.reader_consequence: The Portuguese reader is told, in the case-linelist section, that almost no cleaning will be required; the English text makes no such promise there, so the reader may skip validation of the imported linelist.

findings.heading: Flexdashboard / Painéis com flexdashboard
findings.proposition: The flexdashboard files are R Markdown/HTML source files rather than example datasets, so they are not part of the appliedepidata package and must be downloaded directly from Github.
findings.reader_consequence: The Portuguese reader may look for these dashboard files with get_data() or save_data() in appliedepidata, where they do not exist, instead of downloading them from Github.

findings.heading: Contact Tracing / Rastreamento de contato
findings.proposition: The Go.Data contact tracing data is not part of the appliedepidata package.
findings.reader_consequence: The Portuguese reader may try to load the contact tracing data through appliedepidata::get_data(), which has no such dataset, instead of using the three .rds download links given below.

findings.heading: Time series and outbreak detection / Séries temporais e detecção de surto
findings.proposition: The cross-reference for this dataset points to the Time series and outbreak detection page, which is chapters/time_series.qmd; the Portuguese text links to epidemic_models.pt.qmd, a file that does not exist in chapters/ (time_series.pt.qmd does).
findings.reader_consequence: The Portuguese link is broken, so the reader cannot reach the Séries temporais e detecção de surto page from this dataset entry and may believe the campylobacter data belongs to an epidemic-models page.
